description: This file defines the ImportAccountActivity class for an Android application, responsible for handling account import UI and logic within the Nextcloud Notes project. It manages user interactions for importing accounts, handles results from account selection, manages background tasks for capabilities fetching and account setup, and displays appropriate UI feedback and error handling.

classes.name: ImportAccountActivity
classes.description: An Android activity class responsible for managing the account import process, including UI interactions, handling activity results for account selection, managing background account setup tasks, and providing user feedback and error handling within the Nextcloud Notes application.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI, and configures click listeners for account import actions.

methods.name: onSupportNavigateUp
methods.description: Handles navigation input to support up navigation, setting result as canceled.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from other activities, such as account selection, and orchestrates subsequent account setup and error handling.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles permission request results related to account access.

methods.name: restoreCleanState
methods.description: Resets UI elements to a clean state after errors or cancellation.
